title: Production AI Backend Patterns
description: Apply production-readiness practices to AI-powered .NET backends, including evaluation, observability, safety, and deployment.
longDescription: Moving from prototype to production requires evaluation, guardrails, cost control, and operational visibility. This module covers prompt evaluation, content safety, token budgeting, caching, retries, and deployment patterns for RAG, MCP, and agent systems in .NET.
whatYouLearn: Evaluate retrieval quality, answer relevance, and agent success rates
Apply content filtering and safety checks for user-facing AI features
Control costs with caching, batching, and token budgets
Instrument RAG and agent pipelines with tracing and metrics
Design deployment topologies for AI backends in ASP.NET Core
Count tokens with ITokenizer and read real usage from ChatResponse.Usage
